toegepas.rede_vinder: 'net gedroog' can be read as 'has just dried'; 'slegs' makes clear it means a pot that was dried but not baked.
toegepas.fout: 'net gedroog het' can be read as 'has just dried' rather than 'was only dried, not baked'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'slegs' removes the ambiguity and keeps the intended contrast with the baked pot, without moving the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Hulle is van die algemeenste dinge
toegepas.na: Sulke skerwe is van die algemeenste dinge
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hulle' directly follows 'kleipotte' and can be read as the whole pots; naming the shards makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' follows 'kleipotte' directly and can point to the whole pots or to the shards.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the shards fixes an ambiguous pronoun; the claim stays the same.

toegepas.voor: koppe gevind wat die eerste boere van klei gemaak en gebak het
toegepas.na: koppe gevind wat deur die eerste boere van klei gemaak en gebak is
toegepas.rede_vinder: In the active relative clause 'wat' can grammatically be read as the subject (the heads made the farmers); the passive with 'deur' removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: In the active relative clause 'wat' can be read as the subject, so the heads seem to make the farmers.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The passive with 'deur' removes the grammatical ambiguity with the same people, actions and order.

laat_vaar.voor: Hulle het die sagte klei met patrone
laat_vaar.na: Terwyl die klei nog sag was, het hulle die pot met patrone
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: One decorates the pot, not 'the soft clay'; this also breaks the run of two sentences opening with 'Hulle het' while keeping that the decorating happened before drying.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Decorating the soft clay with patterns is natural Afrikaans and already places it before drying; the proposal is a longer lateral rewrite.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In natural Afrikaans the place phrase comes before the predicate adjective.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'word weer pap in water' is natural Afrikaans with the place phrase moved to the end, so the proposal only changes the word order.
